sourceTitle: Healthy Homemade Soft Chewy Granola Bars from Scratch
sourceText:
Healthy Homemade Soft Chewy Granola Bars from Scratch
By: Homemade & Yummy
Published: Wednesday, February 8, 2017 - 7:01am

Ingredients




Ingredients:
For the Dry mix:
1/4 cup wheat berries (you can use whole wheat flour if you wish)
1/4 cup flaxseeds
3/4 cup old fashioned oats
1/2 cup whole almonds
1/4 cup quinoa flakes
2 tbsp cocoa
For the Wet mix:
1 1/3 cups applesauce (I used strawberry flavoured) (homemade or bought)
1 tsp vanilla
1 tsp chai seasoning blend spice (you can add any spice you like here)
Add ins:
1/2 cup cranberries (and a bit to sprinkle on top)
1/2 cup unsweetened shredded coconut (and a bit to sprinkle on top)

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 350º F. 2 Spray an 8x8 inch baking dish with cooking spray, and line with parchment. 3 Using a blender, combine the dry ingredients (wheat berries, cocoa, oats, quinoa flakes, flaxseeds and almonds). Blitz until it resembles fine breadcrumbs. 4 Place this mixture in a bowl. 5 In a bowl combine the wet ingredients (applesauce, vanilla, & chai spice). 6 Add the wet mixture to the dry mixture, and combine well. 7 Add the cranberries and coconut, and mix to combine. 8 Pour the mixture into the baking dish, and spread evenly in the dish. 9 Sprinkle with additional cranberries and coconut. 10 Bake for approximately 25 minutes. 11 Remove from oven, and let cool in pan. 12 Once cool, remove from pan and place on a cutting board. Cut into 12 (or whatever size you like). 13 ENJOY!!

About
